note: Healthcare facilities in and around Hyderabad, Telangana, used by the Care Finder feature. Names, areas and addresses are real; coordinates are APPROXIMATE map pins (not surveyed entrances) - always confirm the exact entrance, timings and test availability by calling the hospital. Service tags are indicative, not a guarantee of availability.

facilities.name: Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences (NIMS)
facilities.address: Punjagutta Road, near GVK Mall, Hyderabad 500082
facilities.note: Large government tertiary referral centre - very busy OPD; arrive early for tokens.

facilities.name: Osmania General Hospital (OGH)
facilities.note: One of the oldest government hospitals in Hyderabad, close to the old city.

facilities.name: Gandhi Hospital
facilities.note: Major government teaching hospital serving north Hyderabad and Secunderabad.

facilities.name: Sir Ronald Ross Institute of Tropical and Communicable Diseases (Fever Hospital)
facilities.address: Government Fever Hospital, Nallakunta Main Road, Hyderabad 500044
facilities.note: The dedicated government hospital for fevers and communicable diseases - the natural first stop for a high fever in Hyderabad. Call ahead to confirm which tests are running that day.

facilities.name: Apollo Hospitals, Jubilee Hills (Apollo Health City)
facilities.note: Large private multispecialty campus; appointments advised for OPD.

facilities.name: KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad
facilities.address: 1-8-31/1, Minister Road, Krishna Nagar Colony, Secunderabad 500003
facilities.note: Large private multispecialty hospital in central Hyderabad.

facilities.name: AIG Hospitals (Asian Institute of Gastroenterology)
facilities.address: Plot 2/3/4/5, Survey No. 136/1, Mindspace Road, Gachibowli, Hyderabad 500032
facilities.note: Best known for digestive and liver diseases; also a full multispecialty hospital.

facilities.name: Continental Hospitals
facilities.address: Plot 3, Road No. 2, IT and Financial District, Gachibowli, Hyderabad 500032
facilities.note: Convenient for the IT corridor (Gachibowli, Kondapur, Madhapur).

facilities.name: Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda
facilities.address: 6-3-905, Raj Bhavan Road, Matha Nagar, Somajiguda, Hyderabad 500082
facilities.note: Central location close to Punjagutta, Somajiguda and Banjara Hills.

facilities.name: CARE Hospitals, Banjara Hills
facilities.note: Multispecialty private hospital in central Hyderabad.

facilities.name: Rainbow Children's Hospital & BirthRight, Banjara Hills
facilities.address: Road No. 2, near Hotel Park Hyatt, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad 500034
facilities.note: CHILDREN ONLY - good for paediatric fever, but it is not a general adult hospital.

facilities.name: AIIMS Bibinagar
facilities.note: About 45-55 km from central Hyderabad (NH-163 towards Warangal) - allow travel time in an emergency.

facilities.name: ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Sanathnagar
facilities.note: ESIC services may require employee/insurance eligibility - confirm at the help desk.

facilities.name: Government Area Hospital, Kondapur
facilities.address: Near Chirec International School, Kondapur, Hyderabad 500084
facilities.note: Nearest government hospital for the IT corridor; useful for first assessment and basic tests.

facilities.name: Niloufer Hospital for Women and Children
facilities.note: Government referral centre for children and women - not for adult general medicine.

facilities.name: MNJ Institute of Oncology and Regional Cancer Centre
facilities.note: Regional cancer centre for Telangana; referral-based for suspected cancer.

facilities.name: Sarojini Devi Eye Hospital
facilities.note: Dedicated eye hospital - the right place for a painful red eye or any vision change.

facilities.name: Star Hospitals, Banjara Hills
facilities.note: Known for cardiac care; central Hyderabad location.

facilities.name: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre, Ameerpet
facilities.address: Ameerpet main road (near Metro station), Hyderabad 500016
facilities.note: Walk-in blood tests for fever panels (CBC, NS1, Widal, malaria), HbA1c and more. Confirm fasting requirements before you go.

facilities.name: SRL Diagnostics, Himayatnagar
facilities.note: Nationally accredited laboratory chain; useful for a same-day blood panel.

facilities.name: Metropolis Healthcare, Banjara Hills
facilities.note: Good option for routine and fever-related blood tests without a hospital visit.
